status: qualified connected Engram stage; full goal remains active

implementation.architecture: BnModelNativeEngramMath and bn_model_arch_native_engram_math own the explicit BF16-lookup/F16-math bridge, dimensions and once-rounded gate scale. Model adapter exposes it without transformer architecture calls. Scalar query requires FE_TONEAREST, matching source setup. This is not original Diffbot full-forward arithmetic or CLI admission.
implementation.request: TrellisEngram extends the existing canonical TrellisRequest. Model-owned native WKV and raw BF16 K/Q handles are borrowed from the same backend core/parameter owner. Hash layouts, row-ID scratch and nine math views are prepared once; request teardown precedes metadata free.
flow: Raw tokens -> model-owned compressed map -> staged session history
Same history window -> independently resolved layer1/layer14 hash layouts
Shared bounded RAM row cache -> two pinned plane uploads -> canonical request BF16 row bank
Same BF16 resident view -> explicit finite-range FP16 bridge -> two strided GEMMs, grouped norms, dot/gate/residual math
Borrowed result views bound to session, request generation, history epoch, math epoch and row-bank epoch
implementation.batching: Full staged batches must fit a row bank. Capacity is explicit; insufficient capacity rejects during planning. GEMM row counts are preserved rather than silently subdivided into smaller row-bank math tiles.
implementation.history: Setup requires prepared matching host history. The stage never commits history/position/KV. Probe commits only after both Engram layers complete. Whole-model completion gating and actual KV/recurrent-state rewind remain future integration.
implementation.failure: Early metadata rejection and busy leave outputs/history unchanged. Busy performs no cache/LRU/source reads. Storage/domain rejection preserves prior resident results; cache fills may remain. Backend failure destroys the canonical request, preserves uncommitted host history, and requires reset/setup. Late host and device setup failures unwind unpublished request resources.
implementation.compatibility: Existing row-only submit retains its BF16 domain. F16 math uses the new stronger optional submit path, selected through registry-owned behavior and backend policy helpers. No CPU-weight GPU handles, provider math or default generation path added.

finite_f16_domain.boundary: Validate actual decoded BF16 magnitudes before either DMA. BF16 magnitude>=0x4780 overflows finite FP16; integer source-exact decoding handles high scales. Small scales prove an entire block safe without decoding all nibbles.

reference.method: Original Diffbot BF16 lookup corpus -> Torch CPU float16 -> isfinite; first16 scalar nibbles per scale

finite_f16_domain.tests: 507904 original-source scale/nibble decisions match Torch half/isfinite; 479000 accepted. Covers high-scale zero rows, late overflow, invalid scales/geometry and preservation of legacy BF16 staging.

independent_reference.source_methods: Unchanged original NGramEmbedding shift/hash AST and unchanged original Engram math function/kernels from the prior independent capture. Actual raw INT4/scales and original WKV/norm captures. No native candidate import or expected-output generation.
independent_reference.same_history: Prior per-layer raw-token cases differ. Fresh captures explicitly give both layers the same mapped window; five retained layer1 cases also match every old boundary byte-for-byte. Prior artifacts remain unchanged.
independent_reference.streams: Synthetic F32 residual streams; actual model-owned checkpoint projections/norms and actual table rows. No full-model activation/generation claim.
independent_reference.replay: Original packaged-cuBLAS and paired system13.10 captures preserved and replay byte-identically. Native matches paired corpus. Source/parent/input tampering rejects before output; conflicting payload preserved.

validation.baseline: Full standard suite passed before edits

cache.scope: Fresh logical LRU state, not cold physical storage/page cache. Teardown frees are intentionally allowed and separately counted. Shared cache access is caller-serialized.

validation.faults: Budget-1 rejection; late host-controller OOM; final GPU allocation failure; bad metadata; forced busy with byte-identical cache statistics; backend rejection poisons/releases request while history stays pending; reset/setup recovery succeeds.
validation.sanitizers: ASAN/UBSAN cover all new C controller, quant-domain and probe paths; CUDA translation units use normal builds. Memcheck full leaks and initcheck cover the full real-model pipeline, zero errors/leaks. No new GPU kernels; no unbounded whole-core racecheck.
validation.qwen27: Fresh strict CUDA192/192 sampled IDs, first8/8, zero count mismatch, words147/147.
validation.build_correction: Initial full standard run caught a direct quant predicate in transformer code. The capability query moved to backend_quant.h; backend matrix and the complete clean build/suites then passed.

memory_scope.scope: Selected extra allocations only. Base session raw history/logits/arena, native FFN/BLAS request resources, model weights/token map, cache/index metadata, allocator/context overhead and OS page cache are separate.
